name: CEGT Line AD-24 Childes Lateral

values.OtherEnglishNames: CEGT Line 2-AD-24 Childes Lateral; Chiles Dome Storage Expansion lateral
values.StartLocation: Chiles Dome Storage Field, Coal County

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The only nearby row is P0161, the whole Enable Gas Transmission system. This is a separate 2005 lateral built for the Chiles Dome gas storage expansion in Coal, Atoka, Pittsburg and Latimer counties, Oklahoma, under Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP05-58. The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects workbook released August 2026 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 381) lists 24 miles, 16/20/24 inch, 400 MMcf/d, 3.5 million dollars cost, completed 14 December 2005, operator CenterPoint Energy Gas Transmission. A Federal Register scoping notice of 18 March 2005 describes about 23.4 miles of 24-inch pipe from the Chiles Dome storage reservoir to an existing 24-inch CenterPoint line. The February 2005 application notice says about 21 miles. Length is staged as the workbook's 24 miles; the filings say 21 to 23.4 miles, all above the 25 km (15.5 mile) threshold. Diameter is staged as 24 inch per the filing; the workbook lists 16, 20 and 24. The 400 MMcf/d capacity and 3.5 million dollar cost come only from the workbook and look low or odd for a storage lateral (the filing cites storage withdrawal of 309 MMcf/d); treat as unconfirmed. The pipeline is now part of the Enable system, owner spelling matches an existing entity; parent not confirmed. No route was found; no official GIS checked. Confidence medium. Not found: an FERC order or in-service filing stating final as-built length.
